**Inventory built: 16 things already match icon/page/children/navigation, 15 reuse.** [`/imagine/paging/inventory/`](/imagine/paging/inventory/) — one wide table (`.ac("wide")`), 8 columns: page generator · shells · screens · decks · mag · blogx · gallery · feeds · streamed deck · vary · game · team · generated · `ext/tabs` · `ext/catalog` · `ext/layout`+`drawer`. 15 reuse outright (`ext/tabs` already *is* `swap`; `ext/drawer`+`ext/layout` already *is* the persistent right rail `paging/rightnav/` wants; `vary/` and `game/` already show the tone-ladder surfaces), 1 extend (blogx — custom per-shell escape, no shared mechanism), 1 missing (streamed deck — no children, no url, a fifth real paging style outside the four words). Verified headless at 1280 and 3440: 16 rows x 8 cols, zero overflow, zero console errors.

**The `screens/divide/` diagnosis** (fix left to another minion): every hop's `area()` hrefs **forward only** — Two's box is `this.url + "three/"` always, never `this.url` itself, so once Three/Four are open, clicking Two just re-targets the already-active chain and nothing collapses. "Link to itself" means that href becoming conditional on whether a child is already open, so a click on an already-expanded hop navigates *up* and the Router's own `deactivate()` drops what falls off the chain.

**The two counts:** `this.columns()` callers among `public/imagine/*/page.js` = **3** (design, gallery, youtube) of 19 realm root pages. `width: "full"` under `public/**/*.js` = **34** lines — design 14, framework/core 7, decks 5, vary 3, one each in stream/screens/scenes/mag/gallery.

**Left for the mastermind:** `inventory` is not yet in `/imagine/paging/page.js`'s `children:` — that stub is paging-core's, out of this task's fences, so the hub wiring is pending.
